 Print ‘ Ramayana : Part One’ continued its impressive run at the worldwide box office, with the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer inching closer to the Rs 1,500 crore milestone. While on its record-breaking spree, the Nitesh Tiwari directorial witnessed a dip in collections on its second Tuesday (Day 13), earning an estimated Rs 28.70 crore net in India. As per a report on sacnilk, the film witnessed a decline of 10.3 per cent from Monday’s Rs 32 crore haul. However, its good overseas performance continued to its global total, which now stands at Rs 1,483.50 crore gross. Ramayana Movie Review ‘ Ramayana ’ box office collection Day 13 collections
 According to the latest trade figures, the film collected Rs 28.70 crore net in India on Day 13 across 22,551 shows. The film's Hindi shows contributed the largest share, earning Rs 21 crore from 17,867 shows. The language accounted for 73.2 per cent of the film’s Day 13 domestic net collection. The remaining collections came from four other languages. Malayalam brought in Rs 2.35 crore from 1,070 shows, followed by Kannada with Rs 2.10 crore from 894 shows. Tamil contributed Rs 1.75 crore from 1,168 shows, while Telugu added Rs 1.50 crore from 1,552 shows. With this, ‘Ramayana’ has taken its total India net collection to Rs 821.30 crore, while its India gross stands at Rs 981.50 crore. Overseas, the film collected Rs 12 crore gross on its 13th day, taking its cumulative international gross to Rs 502 crore. This brings its worldwide gross collection to Rs 1,483.50 crore. ‘Ramayana’ Week 1 vs Week 2 performance
 The film scored an estimated first-week collection of Rs 564.60 crore net and approximately Rs 675.05 crore gross. Now in its second week, ‘Ramayana’ has collected Rs 310.20 crore net in India so far. With its worldwide gross nearing Rs 1,500 Crore, the film is on the verge of joining an exclusive club. Once it crosses the milestone, ‘Ramayana’ will become only the fifth Indian film to achieve the feat in the fastest time. 'Ramayana' overseas collectons
 According to a report on PTI, the studio has expanded its overseas release from an initial 37 markets to 43 markets, with six additional territories opening last weekend. The film, bankrolled by Namit Malhotra's DNEG and Prime Focus Studios in association with actor Yash's Monster Mind Creations, recorded openings of USD 573,000 (Rs 5.4 crore) in Indonesia and USD 286,000 (Rs 2.7 crore) in Cambodia, which the makers said were records for an Indian film in those markets. It also registered a record opening in Mexico. Among its leading international markets, the film has earned USD 24 million (Rs 225.6 crore) in the US and Canada, USD 5.5 million (Rs 51.7 crore) in the UK, USD 4.7 million (Rs 44.2 crore) in the UAE, USD 4.2 million (Rs 39.5 crore) in Australia, USD 1.5 million (Rs 14.1 crore) in Thailand, USD 1.4 million (Rs 13.2 crore) in Malaysia and USD 1.1 million (Rs 10.3 crore) in Germany.  ‘Ramayana’ ranks No. 3 on IMDb’s Most Popular Movies chart
 Adding to its box office performance, ‘Ramayana’ has also secured the third spot on IMDb’s Most Popular Movies chart worldwide this week. The Nitesh Tiwari directorial is reportedly the only Indian film in the global Top 10, sharing the list with several major Hollywood releases. According to the rankings, ‘Ramayana’ is placed behind ‘You Can See Everything’ and ‘Ebenezer’, while Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ occupies the fourth position. Starring Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana, the film was released in cinemas on November 5.
